evals.prompt: My Redrum beat in Reason 12.7 sounds thin and the drums feel separate from each other. How do I glue it together and get punch plus weight using only stock devices? Short steps.
evals.expected_output: Output Bus (Cmd+G), Master Bus Compressor 2:1 1-3 dB attack 10-30 ms, parallel via Mix 30-50%, saturation with Scream 4, one shared room send, Redrum output jack caveat.
assertions: Places the glue compressor on a drum bus (channels grouped with Cmd+G / Route to New Output Bus) OR inserts it directly after the Redrum, and says which
Warns that using a Redrum individual output jack removes that drum from Redrum's main stereo out (so route it or it disappears from the mix)
Glue compressor at about 2:1 with about 1 to 3 dB of reduction
Attack 10 to 30 ms (or slow-ish attack) so hits still punch through
Parallel compression using a Mix knob around 30 to 50 percent or a Parallel Channel, on a SEPARATE compressor from the glue one (or clearly a second pass)
Adds saturation/grit (Scream 4 or MClass Maximizer) and/or one shared room reverb send
Does not rely on Reason 13/14-only tools (Sidechain Tool, Gain Tool, Stereo Tool)

evals.prompt: Setting up a trap beat in Kong in Reason 12.7 with an 808, clap, closed hat and open hat. Where do I route things, how do I make the two hats choke each other, and how do I make the hats roll? Keep it plain.
evals.expected_output: Drum Output selector to separate jack pairs cabled by hand, Mute Group for hat choke, hat rolls with 16ths/triplets/32nds, Output Bus.
assertions: Uses Kong's Drum Output selector to send pads to their own output pairs and says those outputs are not auto-routed (cable them to Mix Channels yourself)
Puts the closed and open hat pads in one Mute Group for the choke, and says where it is set (Quick Edit in the Pad Group section)
Hat rolls: straight 16ths plus triplets / 32nds / faster bursts at the end of phrases, or a velocity ramp
Gives a trap tempo range of about 60 to 90 BPM or clap/snare on beats 2 and 4
Groups drums on an Output Bus (Cmd+G) or otherwise explains the bus
Does not rely on Reason 13/14-only tools
